paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy, comparing four different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames," has a linear scale with a value range of approximately 0 to 70, and tick labels at regular intervals of 10, with no units specified. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale with a value range of 40 to 54, and tick labels at intervals of 2. There are four lines in the plot: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" in blue with solid lines and no markers, "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" in green with solid lines and no markers, "PLLaVA (DP 8)" in orange with solid lines and square markers, and "PLLaVA (DP 16)" in red with solid lines and square markers. The blue and green lines start at approximately 52.5% accuracy at 10 frames and remain steady at around 54% accuracy as the number of frames increases to 70. The orange line starts at around 45.5% accuracy at 10 frames and decreases to approximately 40% accuracy at 70 frames. The red line starts at around 46% accuracy at 10 frames and decreases to approximately 42.5% accuracy at 70 frames.
